outcome: Stage of breast cancer at diagnosis
cohort: The study included 69 pregnant women (47 with pre-gestational breast cancer and 22 with gestational breast cancer) from a tertiary-level maternity care centre over a 12-year period.
finding: The study concluded comparable overall pregnancy outcomes for women with gestational breast cancer as compared to those with pre-gestational breast cancer, despite GBC patients being more likely to receive surgery and chemotherapy, and experiencing higher rates of induction of labour and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Induction of labour was more common in women with gestational breast cancer compared to those with pre-gestational breast cancer.
